title: The whole component path is played again, now that it has versions and knobs
goal: Component design is the feature in focus, and it has grown a lot in four days: versions, a number you can hand a copy, room on four sides, placing a particular version off the shelf, and carrying one change to every version at once. The last time anyone played the whole path as one sitting was 2026-09-03, before any of that landed. Play it again from nothing, as somebody who has never seen the app: draw a control, make it a component, give it a version and a knob, place three copies, override one, change the original, and put the override back. Then say honestly where it is clumsy.
notes: Follow-on from author-a-component-and-reuse-it-start-to-finish (done 2026-09-03, walk Scripts/playtest/component-end-to-end-walk.json, audit queue/audits/2026-09-03-component-end-to-end.json). Shipped since then and not covered by that walk: a-component-can-hold-more-than-one-version-of-it, a-knob-can-be-a-number (audit 2026-09-06-a-knob-can-be-a-number), room-that-differs-side-to-side-can-be-a-knob (2026-09-06-uneven-room-knob), a-copy-can-have-its-own-room-inside (2026-09-06-component-own-room), place-a-copy-of-a-particular-version-straight-fr (2026-09-06-place-a-version), a-change-can-be-made-to-every-version-of-a-compo (2026-09-06-apply-to-versions), the-dock-opens-on-the-section-that-answers-the-la (2026-09-06-dock-component-first). Filed by the 2026-09-07 digest design review: eight pieces shipped, eight one-feature audits, and no audit anyone could hand a first-time user. Known rough spots to watch for on the way through, from those audits: a knob cannot reach the original's own outermost group; a copy's Version row and knobs sit above Position and Size now, so check the panel still reads in a sensible order; the properties panel may not fit (the-properties-panel-fits-on-the-screen-it-has).
acceptance: One scripted walk drives the whole path end to end and passes twice in a row
It covers the pieces added since 2026-09-03: a second version, a number knob, room as a knob, placing a named version off the shelf, and carrying a change to every version
Every step is checked by what is actually on screen, not by the walk saying it pressed something
One undo puts back each step that claims to be one step
An audit under queue/audits/ that a person could follow with no other reading, with real captures at each turn
The audit says plainly what a first-time user would get wrong, and each of those becomes its own task
The 2026-09-03 walk and audit are either updated or retired, so there is one current answer and not two

log.note: Adversarial pass BEFORE building the walk: the eight audits since 2026-09-03 each proved one feature in its own document, so the risk was writing a ninth. Decided the sitting has to start from a blank canvas and a hand-drawn control, not from a starter tile, because everything a first-time user gets wrong happens before the shelf exists. Also decided against replaying the 2026-09-03 walk with extra steps bolted on: it made its button as a Free group and its room knob would have been decorative.

Foundation the acceptance needed: a walk had no way to CHECK anything. Every step proved a press happened, none proved the app answered. Added an `expect` step to the harness (PhotonzCore model + parser, test-first; driver in PlaytestHarness) that names one thing in the dock and claims either the words it is showing or whether it is there at all. Four things in the Component section had no name a walk could use, so they were given one: the copy's Version menu and the shelf's Place menu (named by their rows, not by the version they show), the way-back arrow (Revert <knob>, and it only names itself while it exists, so present:false means what it looks like), and Edit Original / Detach.

Scripts/playtest/component-whole-path-walk.json: 187 steps, ~30s, green twice in a row and again after every other component walk was re-run. Draw, round, label, group, 16 of room, make component, three knobs off the real Add menu, second version faded, three copies, retype one copy's label, open its room to 48, put both back with the way-back arrow, shelf set to Disabled, a copy that arrives faded, Edit Original, shadow, Apply to Disabled. Undo and redo checked at three of the single-step claims.

Adversarial pass on the BUILT thing, from the real captures: four things a first-time user gets wrong, each filed. two-rows-in-the-add-menu-read-exactly-the-same; a-version-badge-squeezes-a-layer-s-name-out-of-i; adding-a-version-says-where-the-second-drawing-i; more-room-on-a-copy-moves-it-instead-of-making-i. Three rough spots the last sitting flagged are fixed and were checked here: the wording knob arrives called Wording, the number field hands the keyboard back, and there is no halo on text inside a component. The panel also fits, so nothing in the Component section needs scrolling.

Retired the old answer: Scripts/playtest/component-end-to-end-walk.json deleted, queue/audits/2026-09-03-component-end-to-end.json marked supersededBy the new audit, and docs/design/ui-building.md says so. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-07-component-whole-path.json with eight real screen captures (Screen Recording granted).

One sitting, played from a blank canvas: Scripts/playtest/component-whole-path-walk.json, 187 steps, ~30s, green twice in a row and again alongside every other component walk. It covers a second version, a number knob, room as a knob, placing a named version off the shelf and carrying one change to every version, and every turn CLAIMS what the panel is showing through a new expect step in the harness (PhotonzCore model + parser test-first, driver in PlaytestHarness), so the walk fails when the app answers differently rather than when a step falls over. Undo and redo checked at three single-step claims. Four things in the Component section were given names a walk can reach: the copy's Version menu, the shelf's Place menu, the way-back arrow (Revert <knob>, named only while it exists), and Edit Original / Detach. The 2026-09-03 walk is deleted and its audit marked supersededBy, so there is one current answer. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-07-component-whole-path.json with eight real screen captures; four first-time-user problems filed as their own tasks. Scripts/test.sh green (4381 tests). Pushed as d07436a4.
